verdict.rationale: The Superset CLI is documented for use "from your terminal or from CI". The CLI, TypeScript SDK, OpenAPI-backed API and hosted MCP server can all create workspaces and launch agents with a prompt, so a CI job could start an agent with a "fix this failing test" prompt. However, there is no documented CI/CD integration (such as a GitHub Action or build-failure webhook trigger) or any worked example of passing failure context to an agent and producing a fix PR. The local-first, host-based model also means the user must assemble this workflow themselves. Missing for 10: first-party CI/CD trigger integration on build/test failure, documented failure-to-fix workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
